## Schema

### Required

### Read-Only

- `account_id` (String) Account ID for IPAM resource discovery.
- `create_time` (String) IPAM resource discovery creation time.
- `description` (String) IPAM resource discovery description.
- `ipam_resource_discovery_id` (String) IPAM resource discovery ID.

- `ipam_resource_discovery_region_id` (String) Region ID for IPAM resource discovery.

- `is_default` (Boolean) Whether it is the default resource discovery.
- `operating_regions` (Set of String) List of regions where IPAM resource discovery is effective.
- `project_name` (String) Project name for IPAM resource discovery.
- `status` (String) IPAM resource discovery status, such as Available.
- `tags` (Attributes Set) Tag for IPAM resource discovery. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--tags))
